title: Bari Copy Authoring Contract v2
description: v2 (TASK-262/P43): widened to milk-depth content fields. The precise interface between the deterministic build_copy_inputs stage (Part 1) and the author_copy stage (Part 2). A real Content-Agent LLM pass reads this contract and produces the authored-strings JSON that merge_copy.py consumes. The contract is the only place authoring logic is defined: once both sides obey it, no other change is needed to swap in the real author.

author_engine_versions.baseline_placeholder: Deterministic rule-based placeholder. Obeys editorial law. NOT milk-quality. Author = author_copy.py. Mark: author_engine=baseline_placeholder in every authored JSON.
author_engine_versions.content_agent_v1: Real Hebrew content author (LLM, Content Agent). Quality bar = milk-comparison.json. Plugs into the same seam with no code change — reads fact_sheets.json exactly as specified below, writes authored.json exactly as specified below.

_meta.description: Run metadata. Author reads category slug + corpus_stats only.

corpus_stats.description: Per-metric {n, min, max, median} across all products. Used to calibrate relative claims.

ambiguous_drivers.description: Products whose scoring driver could not be resolved. Author writes conservative copy for these — no causal claim.

s_products.description: Barcodes of S-grade products. Their copy is in s_verbatim — author MUST use it verbatim.

sheets.description: One fact sheet per product. Author writes one authored record per sheet.

name.description: Hebrew product name — may be cited literally

driver.description: The real scoring driver. The author tells this story. Never invents a different one.

cap_misclaim_risk.description: TRUE = author must NOT claim the cap is the sole reason. Name the real driver.

nutrition.description: Per-100g values. null stays null — author NEVER asserts a value they do not see here.

ingredients_head.description: First 3 ingredients. null = not available. Author may cite these literally. Never infers ingredients not listed here.

superlatives_allowed.description: Tokens the author MAY use (e.g. 'highest_protein'). Empty = no superlatives permitted for this product.

s_verbatim.description: S-grade only. Author copies these strings BYTE-VERBATIM into insightLine and s_grade_explanation. No paraphrasing.

bari_interpretation_inputs.description: v3 addition. Per-dimension deterministic data (key/label/score/strength) from the BSIP2 trace. Author writes one interpretation sentence per entry. null score → 'נתון לא זמין'.

best_use_cases_pending.description: v3 addition. True = bestUseCases was PENDING_COPY in the page (author must fill). False = already deterministic; author uses best_use_cases_deterministic as-is.

best_use_cases_deterministic.description: v3 addition. When best_use_cases_pending=False, these are the already-filled tags. Author passes them through unchanged.

products.description: Map of barcode (string) -> product copy record. Must cover every barcode in fact_sheets.sheets.

insightLine.description: Exactly one standalone sentence (no trailing period). Grade as badge only — never spelled out in prose. No framework vocabulary. max ~90 chars. Must pass hebrew_readability.analyze is_clean=True.

rowVerdict.description: 2-3 sentences. States: what the score stands for → the honest limiting factor or strength. No sodium/fat as causal claims. No banned phrases. Must pass is_clean=True.

comparisonContext.description: 1-2 sentences placing this product on the shelf vs peers. May cite numeric facts from the fact sheet. No grade re-statement. Passes is_clean=True.

positiveSignals.description: 1-3 observable strengths. Short bullets. Grounded in fact-sheet data only. Each passes is_clean=True.

limitingFactors.description: 0-2 compositional limits. Omit when empty (schema: absent when no limits). Each passes is_clean=True.

consumerExplanation.description: v3 addition. Structured multi-part explanation (milk-depth). All sub-fields must be non-PENDING in the authored output.

whyRated.description: One sentence. Why the product received its score. Grade badge only. Passes is_clean=True.

good.description: Observed strengths (richer/longer than positiveSignals). Each passes is_clean=True.

watchOut.description: Caution signals. Empty array when none. Each passes is_clean=True.

context.description: One sentence placing on shelf vs peers. Passes is_clean=True.

s_grade_explanation.description: S-grade products ONLY. Copied byte-verbatim from s_verbatim. Absent for non-S products.

consumerTakeaway.description: v3 addition. One-line plain Hebrew summary. Same editorial law as insightLine. Passes is_clean=True. Max ~90 chars.

bariInterpretation.description: v3 addition. Per-dimension authored list. key/label/score/strength from the fact sheet (pass through unchanged); author writes interpretation sentence. null score → 'נתון לא זמין'.

interpretation.description: One short Hebrew sentence. No framework vocabulary. Passes is_clean=True.

bestUseCases.description: v3 addition. Consumer use-case tags (Hebrew). When best_use_cases_pending=False, pass best_use_cases_deterministic through unchanged. When pending=True, author writes a list of 1-3 short Hebrew tags grounded in facts.

_page.description: Page-level authored strings. Written under _meta.page_copy by merge_copy.py.

story_headline.description: Hebrew headline for the comparison page. Max ~100 chars. Passes is_clean=True.

story_teaser.description: 1-2 sentences expanding on the headline. Passes is_clean=True.

philosophy_note.description: Standard Bari methodology disclaimer (Hebrew). Passes is_clean=True.

editorial_law.description: Mandatory constraints for EVERY author engine, including the baseline placeholder.
rules: standalone_lines: each insightLine is one complete standalone sentence — no opening fragments, no trailing qualifiers bleeding into the next line
grade_in_prose_equals_badge: the only place the letter grade appears is as a badge (the score display); never spell it out in prose as a Hebrew equivalent letter
sodium_fat_never_causal: sodium and fat are displayed as facts; never frame them as the cause of a score (no 'because of sodium', 'due to fat content')
no_framework_leakage: NOVA, BSIP, cap, floor, penalty, dimension, confidence_score, etc. must never appear in any consumer string
null_stays_null: if a nutrition fact is null in the fact sheet, the author writes nothing about that fact — never substitutes or infers
no_OFF: no Open Food Facts data may be asserted — the only source is the fact sheet
no_banned_phrases: the 9 banned phrases from Explanation Engine v2 are forbidden (see run_gates.py BANNED_PHRASES_HE)
no_recommendation_language: Bari describes, never prescribes; 'recommended', 'you should buy', 'avoid' are forbidden
s_verbatim_verbatim: S-grade insightLine and s_grade_explanation are copied byte-verbatim from s_verbatim in the fact sheet; no paraphrasing

milk_depth_note: v2 contract (TASK-262/P43): schema_carries_milk_depth=TRUE. All 4 per-product milk fields are now first-class in canonical-v3: consumerTakeaway, consumerExplanation.{whyRated/good/watchOut/context/takeaway}, bariInterpretation[] (det+authored), bestUseCases[] (det+authored). Page-level story_headline/story_teaser/philosophy_note already in _meta.page_copy via additionalProperties:true. The authoring contract v2 declares all inputs and outputs needed for a Content-Agent LLM pass to produce milk-quality copy without any code change.
